edit.description: `read_layout_document` (:2025) splits into the lowering half — the same parameters plus the document's **text** — and a thin reading wrapper that keeps today's `DriftError::Read` mapping, so `derive_layout_rows` (:1972) stays on the wrapper unchanged. A `thread_local` read counter plus a `layout_document_read_count()` accessor join the module's existing three (`lock_read_count` :58, `lock_parse_count` :65, `manifest_read_count` :72), bumped in the wrapper so the counted quantity is exactly the disk reads.

`local_document_rows` (:893) lowers each member's rows off `unit.body` — which `layout_unit` (:582) already set to the document's whole raw text, the identical string `read_layout_document` re-reads and re-parses — instead of handing `unit.source_path` back to disk (:918). Same discipline `assemble_lock_family` already states for the units it retains beside the rows so `read_dial` needs no second resolution of the same kind (:1100).

The count pin, beside the walk and read pins already here: `compose::assemble_lock_family` over a two-member local layout kind reads two documents, where the pass reads four today (one per member in `resolve_kind_units`, one per member in the row derivation). Pass granularity, stated in the test: the gate's own per-kind resolution is a separate reader this entry does not touch, so the pin is read before and after that one call rather than around `gate::gate`. Non-vacuity first — the derived `nested` rows must be non-empty before the count is asserted.

The `knob` local-layout fixture moves here — `knob_layout_row` and `knob_kind_facts` — so the new pin and the behavior suite read one home (`engineering.md`, "One job, one home": test scaffolding is a surface too). `common::kind_facts` (:1170), which `knob_kind_facts` already builds on, and `common::write_lock` (:943) both live here already.

Its `knob_layout_row` (:56) and `knob_kind_facts` (:93) move to `common`; the three construction sites (:96, :596, :620) read them from there. No behavior change — the whole suite must stay green over the moved fixture.

summary: A local layout kind's document is read twice per pass — the row derivation re-reads bytes the unit already carries; hoist to one read and pin it by count.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

tests.asserts: assemble_lock_family over a two-member local layout kind reads two documents, the derived nested rows asserted non-empty first

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the new count pin: one layout-document disk read per local layout member per `assemble_lock_family` pass, where that pass reads each member's document twice today.
notes: Found in the post-ship audit's cost-class census: `layout_unit` sets `Unit.body` to the whole document, then `local_document_rows` hands `unit.source_path` back to `drift::read_layout_document`, re-reading and re-parsing it. The second in-memory `layout.read` parse stays — the disk read is the cost the cited section names. LAYOUT-DOCUMENT-READ-FOLDS-ONTO-THE-SHARED-PRIMITIVE is blocked on this entry: same two sites. scoped at 6c6146e0
